en: A black‑and‑white aerial view of a large industrial complex surrounded by forest, lakes and a scattered town. Several long factory halls with saw‑tooth and gabled roofs, tall brick smokestacks emitting light smoke, and rail sidings dominate the center. In the foreground stands a prominent multi‑storey manor‑like building with a central dome and formal entrance, set within landscaped grounds and trees. Beyond the factories are wooden houses and villas along the lakeshore and within the forested hills. There is no printed caption or other visible text on the image.
